results.summary_before: This project implements an 8-bit linear feedback shift register that produces a pseudo-random sequence. It is used by reading the output pins, which change on each clock cycle, and can be seeded by setting the write enable pin high while providing a seed on the input pins. No external hardware is needed other than a way to read the output pins. The design is a straightforward LFSR implementation with no notable limitations mentioned.

results.summary_before: This is an all-digital phase-locked loop (PLL) implemented in RTL, operating at 2 MHz with a 50 MHz sampling clock and programmable parameters. It includes a digitally controlled oscillator (DCO) and provides outputs for lock detection and sign. Testing involves stepping the frequency and measuring lock time and jitter, requiring a function generator, oscilloscope, and external VCO. The design is notable for being fully digital and programmable.

results.summary_before: This project is a fully differential two-stage operational amplifier using a folded cascode followed by a common source stage. It has analog inputs for the differential signal, analog outputs for the differential output, a common-mode input pin, and two digital inputs to select between self-bias and external current source biasing. Testing is planned with an AD03 board to build a band-pass filter and measure linearity, offset voltage and current, CMRR, and PSRR. The design requires either a resistor for self-bias or an external current source, depending on the chosen biasing method.

results.summary_before: This is a small CPU based on an enhanced version of Emil Post's machine, with an eight-instruction set, a 256x4-bit code ROM and a 256x1-bit data RAM in a Harvard arrangement. Programs and data are loaded and read back over a slave SPI interface, and a MODE pin selects programming versus execution while RUN starts the program. The design exposes internal buses on OUT8B and OUT3B under control of a three-bit selector, and it is intended as a teaching resource for computer architecture. The documentation is detailed, including instruction encoding, SPI word format and timing diagrams.
